newsitem.title: USA: GreenMan to buy Browning-Ferris units.
newsitem.headline: GreenMan to buy Browning-Ferris units.

text.p: GreenMan Technologies Inc said on Friday it signed a letter of intent to buy tire-recycling operations from Browning-Ferris Inc that would triple GreenMan's annual revenues.
The terms of the deal were not disclosed. GreenMan reported revenues of $4.39 million for the year ending May 31, 1996.
GreenMan plans to acquire tire-recycling operations in Jackson, Ga., and Savage, Minn., as well as certain tire-related assets in Azusa, Calif.

"Together some 20 million tires per year are represented, which will assure GreenMan of a reliable and cost-effective source of raw material for its operations," GreenMan Chief Executive Maury Needham said in a statement.
The deal also would eliminate GreenMan's "take or pay" obligation under an existing agreement, dropping $24 million over the term of that arrangement to GreenMan's bottom line, the company said.
GreenMan makes "environmentally friendly" rubber and plastic-based products.
